ASAM UI PRO

卡片列表

AsamCardList

把列表结果按网格或瀑布流排列，支持封面与当前页选择。

使用场景

使用内容映射提供标题、封面与摘要。通过 operation 插槽在卡片底部展示更新时间和详情操作。

卡片布局与容器宽度

用查询卡片应用布局选项，拖动列表右侧手柄调整宽度。滚动到列表底部加载更多项目，部分封面会在项目加载后显示。

vue
<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">
		<AsamSearchForm
			v-model="draft"
			:fields="fields"
			:reset-values="defaultQuery"
			@submit="applyQuery"
			@reset="applyQuery"
		/>
		<div ref="previewHost" class="card-preview-host">
			<div
				class="card-layout-preview"
				:style="{ maxWidth: previewWidth === undefined ? undefined : previewWidth + 'px' }"
			>
				<div
					v-if="cardType === 'projects'"
					v-asam-infinite-scroll="loadMore"
					:infinite-scroll-disabled="scrollDisabled"
					:infinite-scroll-distance="24"
					:infinite-scroll-immediate="false"
				>
					<AsamCardList
						class="card-layout-content"
						:controller="controller"
						:content="content"
						:layout="layout"
						:columns="columnMode"
						:card-size="cardSize"
						:gap="gap"
						selectable
						hide-refresh
						hide-ready-status
						hide-pagination
						:label="layout === 'masonry' ? '项目进展瀑布流' : '项目卡片列表'"
					>
						<template #error="{ message }">
							<div v-if="readMode === 'first'" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
								{{ message }}
								<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
						<template #meta="{ row }">
							<AsamTag
								:type="row.status === '已完成' ? 'success' : 'info'"
								effect="light"
							>
								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:press-animation="false"
					aria-label="调整容器宽度"
					title="拖动调整宽度，方向键微调"
					@pointerdown="beginResize"
					@pointermove="resizePreview"
					@lostpointercapture="dragOrigin = undefined"
					@keydown.left.prevent="nudgePreview(-10)"
					@keydown.right.prevent="nudgePreview(10)"
				>
					<MoreFilled class="card-preview-handle-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer
			:model-value="!!active"
			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"
			@update:model-value="close"
		>
			<p v-if="active">
				<strong>{{ active.name }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p v-if="active">{{ active.description }}</p>
		</AsamDrawer>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta: number) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef<Row>();
const readMode = shallowRef<'first' | 'append'>('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index: number): Row => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]!
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller: AsamListController<Row> = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});

const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});

function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});

function applyQuery(query: AsamFieldModel) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);

	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}

	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row: Row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value: string) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">

						:layout="layout"
						:columns="columnMode"
						:card-size="cardSize"
						:gap="gap"
						selectable
						hide-refresh
						hide-ready-status
						hide-pagination

						<template #meta="{ row }">
							<AsamTag
								:type="row.status === '已完成' ? 'success' : 'info'"

								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain

					aria-label="调整容器宽度"

				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer

			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"

<script setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
defineProps({
	layout: { type: String, required: true }
});
const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
};
const draft = shallowRef({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef();
const previewHost = shallowRef();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin;
let hostObserver;
const detailLabel = (name) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });
function choiceField(key, label, options) {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key, label, min, max) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value, fallback) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice(value, labels) {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}
const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});
onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});
function setPreviewWidth(width) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef();
const readMode = shallowRef('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3],
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay, signal) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});
function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});
function applyQuery(query) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);
	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}
	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamCardList, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { AsamRadioButton, AsamRadioGroup, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardPreset } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string };
const records: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	status: '进行中'
}));
const presets: readonly AsamCardPreset[] = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardPreset>('default');
function setCardSize(value: unknown) {
	const preset = presets.find((item) => item === value);
	if (preset) cardSize.value = preset;
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	pageSize: 20,
	api: async (request) => {
		return {
			list: records.slice(
				(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
				request.currentPage * request.pageSize
			),
			total: records.length
		};
	}
});

const content = (row: Row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.status });
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
</script>

			aria-label="卡片尺寸"
			@update:model-value="setCardSize"
		>
			<AsamRadioButton v-for="preset in presets" :key="preset" :value="preset">
				{{ preset }}
			</AsamRadioButton>
		</AsamRadioGroup>
		<AsamCardList
			:controller="controller"
			:content="content"
			label="项目列表"
			selectable
			:card-size="cardSize"
			size="small"
			hide-refresh
			hide-ready-status
			hide-pagination
		/>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamCardList, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { AsamRadioButton, AsamRadioGroup, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
const records = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	status: '进行中'
}));
const presets = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const cardSize = shallowRef('default');
function setCardSize(value) {
	const preset = presets.find((item) => item === value);
	if (preset) cardSize.value = preset;
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	pageSize: 20,
	api: async (request) => {
		return {
			list: records.slice(
				(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
				request.currentPage * request.pageSize
			),
			total: records.length
		};
	}
});
const content = (row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.status });
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
</script>

用查询卡片调整列数、卡片尺寸和间距，拖动右侧手柄改变列表宽度。长短不同的卡片按实际高度交错排列，滚动到底部继续加载。

<template>

					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"

					<AsamStatisticCard

						title="指标卡片"

			</p>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta: number) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef<Row>();
const readMode = shallowRef<'first' | 'append'>('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index: number): Row => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]!
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller: AsamListController<Row> = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});

const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});

function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});

function applyQuery(query: AsamFieldModel) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);

	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}

	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row: Row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value: string) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open: boolean) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

							>
								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:press-animation="false"
					aria-label="调整容器宽度"
					title="拖动调整宽度，方向键微调"
					@pointerdown="beginResize"
					@pointermove="resizePreview"
					@lostpointercapture="dragOrigin = undefined"
					@keydown.left.prevent="nudgePreview(-10)"
					@keydown.right.prevent="nudgePreview(10)"
				>
					<MoreFilled class="card-preview-handle-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer
			:model-value="!!active"
			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"
			@update:model-value="close"
		>
			<p v-if="active">
				<strong>{{ active.name }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p v-if="active">{{ active.description }}</p>
		</AsamDrawer>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
defineProps({
	layout: { type: String, required: true }
});
const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
};
const draft = shallowRef({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef();
const previewHost = shallowRef();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin;
let hostObserver;
const detailLabel = (name) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });
function choiceField(key, label, options) {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key, label, min, max) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value, fallback) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice(value, labels) {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}
const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});
onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});
function setPreviewWidth(width) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef();
const readMode = shallowRef('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3],
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay, signal) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});
function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});
function applyQuery(query) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);
	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}
	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '卡片布局与容器宽度 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '卡片布局与容器宽度 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/ts', label: '选择与尺寸 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/js', label: '选择与尺寸 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'masonry/ts', label: '瀑布流 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'masonry/js', label: '瀑布流 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/js/Demo.vue')),
	'masonry/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/masonry/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'masonry/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/masonry/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">
		<AsamSearchForm
			v-model="draft"
			:fields="fields"
			:reset-values="defaultQuery"
			@submit="applyQuery"
			@reset="applyQuery"
		/>
		<div ref="previewHost" class="card-preview-host">
			<div
				class="card-layout-preview"
				:style="{ maxWidth: previewWidth === undefined ? undefined : previewWidth + 'px' }"
			>
				<div
					v-if="cardType === 'projects'"
					v-asam-infinite-scroll="loadMore"
					:infinite-scroll-disabled="scrollDisabled"
					:infinite-scroll-distance="24"
					:infinite-scroll-immediate="false"
				>
					<AsamCardList
						class="card-layout-content"
						:controller="controller"
						:content="content"
						:layout="layout"
						:columns="columnMode"
						:card-size="cardSize"
						:gap="gap"
						selectable
						hide-refresh
						hide-ready-status
						hide-pagination
						:label="layout === 'masonry' ? '项目进展瀑布流' : '项目卡片列表'"
					>
						<template #error="{ message }">
							<div v-if="readMode === 'first'" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
								{{ message }}
								<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
						<template #meta="{ row }">
							<AsamTag
								:type="row.status === '已完成' ? 'success' : 'info'"
								effect="light"
							>
								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:press-animation="false"
					aria-label="调整容器宽度"
					title="拖动调整宽度，方向键微调"
					@pointerdown="beginResize"
					@pointermove="resizePreview"
					@lostpointercapture="dragOrigin = undefined"
					@keydown.left.prevent="nudgePreview(-10)"
					@keydown.right.prevent="nudgePreview(10)"
				>
					<MoreFilled class="card-preview-handle-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer
			:model-value="!!active"
			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"
			@update:model-value="close"
		>
			<p v-if="active">
				<strong>{{ active.name }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p v-if="active">{{ active.description }}</p>
		</AsamDrawer>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}

			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),

		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'

		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;

	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';

	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)

const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'

	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});

	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta: number) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef<Row>();
const readMode = shallowRef<'first' | 'append'>('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index: number): Row => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]!
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller: AsamListController<Row> = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});

const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});

function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});

function applyQuery(query: AsamFieldModel) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);

	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),

# AsamCardList 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

API

属性 AsamCardListProps

属性名说明类型默认值
disabled是否禁用交互。boolean | undefined—
columns列配置。enum"auto"完整类型：number | "auto" | undefined—
controller管理数据、状态与操作的控制器。AsamListController<Row>—
size组件尺寸。enum"large" | "big" | "default" | "small"完整类型：(AsamCardListProps<Row>)["size"]—
label可访问名称。string—
minWidth最小布局宽度。number | undefined—
cardSize卡片几何尺寸预设或自定义尺寸，独立于按钮和表单控件尺寸。enum"large" | "big" | "default" | "small"完整类型：(AsamCardListProps<Row>)["cardSize"]—
maxWidth卡片布局的最大宽度，支持数值或 CSS 长度。(AsamCardListProps<Row>)["maxWidth"]—
gap卡片之间的间距，支持数值或 CSS 长度。(AsamCardListProps<Row>)["gap"]—
readonly是否只读。boolean | undefined—
content显示的内容。(row: Row) => AsamListContent—
actions操作项配置。readonly AsamListAction<Row>[] | undefined—
selectable是否显示选择控件。boolean | undefined—
hideRefresh隐藏工具栏中的刷新按钮，错误状态仍可重试。boolean | undefined—
hideReadyStatus隐藏正常结果的就绪提示，保留加载、空结果和错误提示。boolean | undefined—
hidePagination隐藏内置页码和每页条数控件，加载及累积结果由宿主管理。boolean | undefined—
rowActions行操作配置。readonly AsamListAction<Row>[] | undefined—
sorts只提交声明的远程排序，不在当前页本地排序。readonly { readonly label: string; readonly value: AsamListSort | null; }[] | undefined—
layout布局方式。enum"grid" | "masonry"完整类型："grid" | "masonry" | undefined—

import type { ComputedRef, Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamCardListProps, AsamListController, AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel, AsamListIntent, AsamFieldIssue, AsamListValidation, AsamListActionResult, AsamListSort, AsamListAction, AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamCardListProps
type PublicContract<Row extends object> = {
	readonly "disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "columns"?: number | "auto" | undefined;
	readonly "controller": AsamListController<Row>;
	readonly "size"?: (AsamCardListProps<Row>)["size"];
	readonly "label": string;
	readonly "minWidth"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "cardSize"?: (AsamCardListProps<Row>)["cardSize"];
	readonly "maxWidth"?: (AsamCardListProps<Row>)["maxWidth"];
	readonly "gap"?: (AsamCardListProps<Row>)["gap"];
	readonly "readonly"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "content": (row: Row) => AsamListContent;
	readonly "actions"?: readonly AsamListAction<Row>[] | undefined;
	readonly "selectable"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "hideRefresh"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "hideReadyStatus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "hidePagination"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "rowActions"?: readonly AsamListAction<Row>[] | undefined;
	readonly "sorts"?: readonly { readonly label: string; readonly value: AsamListSort | null; }[] | undefined;
	readonly "layout"?: "grid" | "masonry" | undefined;
};
